pentominoes.evidence: Three-page print-to-PDF of Rashmi Bhat and Audrey Fletcher’s November 20, 1995 Andrews University educational article, preserved on Jim Storer’s Brandeis University puzzle site. All pages read and original title page inspected. Covers the twelve five-square shapes, rotation/reflection equivalence, 8×8 checkerboard puzzles and the actual competitive game: choose an unused piece, place without overlap or extending beyond the board, last player able to place wins. Not a Domineering or publisher-specific 10×10 substitute. Modern puzzle/history commentary is not independently verified; figures and exact solution-count conventions are not certified. Summary has a specific victory/pool conflict recorded separately; no full audit.

rise-and-decline-of-the-third-reich.evidence: Wargame Academy 55-page amplified/reformatted fourth-edition rules, version 070908, explicitly titled The Rise and Decline of the Third Reich; linked on the archive’s Third Reich page. Complete readable core rules 1–52, questions/edition notes, sequence charts, percentages and optional possibilities are present. Includes BRP/year start, objective/scenario victory, movement/combat/attrition/pass, construction/redeployment, supply, air/naval warfare, national special rules and multiplayer/sample turn. Original title and internal page inspected and text coverage checked throughout. This is a community-amplified fourth-edition reference with colored clarifications/variants, not an untouched Avalon Hill original or Advanced Third Reich. Source-specific modifications remain visible; original scenario cards/map/counters are separate components and are referenced rather than all reproduced. No summary audit.

caesars-legions.evidence: Vassal public module 2.4 inspected as a ZIP without executing code; contains readme.txt but no PDF/HTML/DOC rules or rules-named text. Module alone is not counted as recovered rules.

hitler-s-war.evidence: Wargame Academy HTW index and linked article index contain no downloadable main rules; indexes alone are not usable rules.

followup.evidence: The earlier index/modified-rule/supplement results remain as recorded. A newly inspected archive supplies the complete original Avalon Hill manual; the house revision is still not accepted.

beda-fomm.evidence: GMT links to Consim Press for support; direct publisher URL fails DNS. Search finds only an eight-rule reminder and a sequence-of-play aid, neither accepted as the main rulebook.
